_example._exampleNote: Placeholder example. Fill from the actual hadith book: collection/book/chapter/number must be exact, translations written from the published translation in hand.

_note: VERIFICATION POLICY: hadith text and translations may ONLY be entered from the actual collection (collectionName/book/chapter/hadithNumber must be exact and checkable). grading must name its source. Rows with placeholder "…" text are rejected by scripts/seed-sample-hadiths.ts. New content enters as status "draft".

_schema.arabicText: Arabic matn from the collection (optional; placeholder rejected)
_schema.bengaliTranslation: Bengali translation from a published translation (optional; placeholder rejected)
_schema.collectionName: exact collection name, e.g. Sahih al-Bukhari or Al-Kafi (required)
_schema.grading: e.g. Sahih / Hasan / Da'if / Muwaththaq (optional, with gradingSource)
_schema.hadithNumber: number in the standard numbering of that edition (optional but required before publishing)
_schema.sourceUrl: link to a legitimate online edition if available (optional)
_schema.status: draft | review | published — always seed as "draft" (optional, default draft)
